ui.procedures.badge.withheld: Left out of the agents' list
ui.procedures.delete.confirm: Delete “{title}”? Its file is removed and its id is never used again. An agent that holds it is told it is gone.
ui.procedures.delete.title: Delete {title}
ui.procedures.edit.lead: Your edit goes through the same checks as an agent's: the app refuses what it cannot keep and says which field and why. Never write a password, a token, a name, an address or an account number: write <value> where a value goes.
ui.procedures.edit.limits: Limits: a title of {title} characters; {steps} steps of {stepText} characters, each with a command of {stepRun}; {pitfalls} pitfalls of {pitfall} characters; {waits} waits of {wait} characters.
ui.procedures.edit.notSaved: Not saved. Fix these and save again:
ui.procedures.edit.runPlaceholder: Command, or a control by its role and visible label
ui.procedures.edit.title: Editing {title}
ui.procedures.empty: No agent has kept a procedure yet.
ui.procedures.error.cap: There are too many procedures for this kind and key, or in the workspace. Delete one first.
ui.procedures.error.duplicate: A procedure with this title already exists for this kind and key: edit that one instead.
ui.procedures.error.gone: This procedure is gone: it was deleted or never existed.
ui.procedures.error.io: The procedure could not be written. Nothing was changed.
ui.procedures.error.newer: This procedure was written by a newer app and is left alone.
ui.procedures.error.noPrevious: This procedure has no earlier version to restore.
ui.procedures.error.revision: This procedure changed since you opened it. Read it again, then edit.
ui.procedures.field.pitfalls: What to avoid, one per line
ui.procedures.field.title: Title
ui.procedures.field.waits: What to wait for, one per line
ui.procedures.filter.label: Filter the procedures
ui.procedures.lead: What the agents of this workspace worked out about recurring tasks, kept so the next agent reads it first and explores only what changed. You can read each one, see who wrote it and what it saved.
ui.procedures.leadWeb: Here you can read them. Editing, marking as reviewed and deleting are done on the computer.
ui.procedures.list.label: Procedures
ui.procedures.loadError: The procedures could not be read.
ui.procedures.off: Procedures are off in this workspace (Settings › Runner): agents neither read nor write them. What is kept stays here to read.
ui.procedures.offDesktop: Procedures are off in this workspace (Settings › Runner): agents neither read nor write them. What is kept stays here for you to read, edit or delete.
ui.procedures.offer.duplicate: A procedure with this title already exists for this kind and key. Change the title, or answer No.
ui.procedures.offer.expires: If you do not answer, it goes away after 24 hours.
ui.procedures.offer.gone: This offer is no longer there: it was answered, replaced or has expired.
ui.procedures.offer.handoff: You used the agent's screen in this work, so what you typed may have reached the text above. Read it before you keep it.
ui.procedures.offer.label: Offer to keep a procedure from the work of {agent}
ui.procedures.offer.lead: {agent} did this work and nobody saved a procedure for it. This is what the app recorded of it. If you keep it, every agent of the workspace can read it.
ui.procedures.offer.leftOut: Commands left out of this draft for safety: {count}.
ui.procedures.offer.title: Keep this as a procedure?
ui.procedures.panel.awaitsReview: You used the agent's screen while it wrote this revision, so what you typed may have reached its text. No agent reads it until you check it and mark it as reviewed.
ui.procedures.panel.invalid: This file is not a readable procedure.
ui.procedures.panel.keyedByApp: The site was taken from the pages the agent's browser visited.
ui.procedures.panel.missing: This procedure is gone: it was deleted or never existed.
ui.procedures.panel.newer: This procedure was written by a newer app and is left alone.
ui.procedures.panel.old: Not verified for more than 90 days.
ui.procedures.panel.stateFailing: An agent reported step {step} as not working on {date}. Agents follow only the parts that still hold until one replaces it.
ui.procedures.panel.stateOk: Last used on {date} with no failure reported. That is all the app can tell: nobody tested the steps.
ui.procedures.panel.stateUnverified: Not confirmed by a later use yet.
ui.procedures.panel.stepsAgent: The steps were written by the agent.
ui.procedures.panel.stepsEdited: The steps are the app's recording, with some reworded.
ui.procedures.panel.stepsRecording: The steps are the app's recording of what the screen did.
ui.procedures.panel.unreviewed: You have not reviewed this revision. Agents read it as it is, marked as not reviewed.
ui.procedures.panel.usage.approximate: Approximate: the call that found it and the ones that used it did other work too, so this compares and does not measure.
ui.procedures.panel.usage.noBaseline: What finding it cost is not known: the call that created it has not finished.
ui.procedures.panel.usage.noSaving: A use costs as much as finding it did, or more: no saving to show.
ui.procedures.panel.usage.notEnough: Not enough uses to compare: {counted} counted, at least {needed} are needed.
ui.procedures.panel.usage.saved: About {tokens} tokens saved: what finding it cost, minus the average use, times the uses.
ui.procedures.panel.usage.savedCost: About {tokens} tokens saved, and about {cost} reported by the provider.
ui.procedures.panel.usage.savedCostEstim: About {tokens} tokens saved, and about {cost} estimated.
ui.procedures.panel.withheld: It failed twice since it was last saved, so the agents' list leaves it out. Correct it or delete it.
ui.procedures.refusal.charset: may hold only letters, digits, spaces and . , - / ( ) '
ui.procedures.refusal.control: has a line break or a control character; one line only
ui.procedures.refusal.credential: has what looks like a credential; write <value> where a value goes
ui.procedures.refusal.digits: has a run of 6 or more digits (an account number, a code, a phone); write <value> where it goes
ui.procedures.refusal.email: has an email address; write <your login> or <value> instead
ui.procedures.refusal.home: has a home folder path; write a path from the repository or from ~
ui.procedures.refusal.keyForm: is not in the form its kind takes: a host or an application name, or a lowercase slug
ui.procedures.refusal.keyRepo: is not a repository of this workspace
ui.procedures.refusal.keyStage: is not a stage kind of the flow, optionally followed by @ and a repository
ui.procedures.refusal.quote: quotes more than 40 characters; name a control by its role and visible label, never by page content
ui.procedures.refusal.size: is too long in all: shorten the steps or split the procedure
ui.procedures.refusal.token: has a string of 20 or more characters with no space that mixes letters and digits (a token, a key, an id); write <value> or :id
ui.procedures.refusal.tooLong: is too long for this field
ui.procedures.refusal.unknownField: is not a field of a step
ui.procedures.refusal.urlQuery: has a URL with a query string or a fragment; keep the path only
ui.procedures.skipped: {count} files in the procedures folder were not read: written by a newer app, or not a procedure.
ui.procedures.summary.label: The workspace's procedures in numbers
ui.procedures.summary.noSaving: No saving to show yet: a procedure needs at least 3 uses that cost less than finding it did.
ui.procedures.summary.saved: About {tokens} tokens saved in {procedures} procedures with enough uses. Approximate: see each procedure.
ui.procedures.summary.savedCost: About {tokens} tokens saved in {procedures} procedures with enough uses, and about {cost} reported by the provider. Approximate: see each procedure.
ui.procedures.summary.savedCostEstimated: About {tokens} tokens saved in {procedures} procedures with enough uses, and about {cost} estimated. Approximate: see each procedure.
ui.procedures.surface.called: a conversation with an agent another one called
ui.procedures.title: Learned procedures
